declared_domain_assumptions: The report identity denotes one particular artifact version selected by this interpretation, not every file sharing the path environment-check.md. No approval is inferred from review.
Review and submission use that available artifact version. Availability after its generation is a well-formedness condition; review-before-submission is separately required by c09.
No parent requirement is added that all checks finish before report generation, or that all parent activities be serial. Serial stages are the candidates' own choice.
An event flag denotes the complete typed predicate and role binding in its cited claim, not merely occurrence of its verb.
Deadline is evaluated at the whole-task due checkpoint; candidates choose a serial schedule with no uncounted overhead.
The prohibition has task-wide scope; no actor authority is derived from role rank.
